Capital Tankers Corp. (Euronext Growth Oslo: CAPT) is a Marshall Islands-incorporated owner of modern crude and product tankers trading its vessels predominantly in the spot and short-term charter markets. The Company owns a fleet of 33 latest generation eco vessels --- 15 VLCCs, 10 Suezmax and eight Aframax/LR2 tankers --- comprising 15 sailing vessels and 18 newbuildings scheduled for delivery between 2026 and 2028, with options for 13 additional crude tankers. 23 of the 33 vessels are dual-fuel LNG ready or capable, providing the Company with significant potential fuel and regulatory cost advantages.
